description: Prices one exact job with Printdash's pricing engine: a product id and a configuration of option ids (from get_product or match_options). Returns the price ex GST, GST and total inc GST, turnaround, a config_id and a share_url that opens the job on printdash.io; with an Australian postcode (or, signed in, a saved address id) the delivered price too. Signed in, the price is the customer's own account price. If the job cannot be priced it says what is missing, what is wrong, or the nearest combinations that can be. Relay prices exactly as returned. Printdash prints in Australia and delivers within Australia only; prices are in AUD and include GST.

address_id.description: Signed in: a saved address id from list_addresses, instead of a postcode.

configuration.description: The job, as option ids from get_product. Everything optional: the result says what is missing.

attributeSelections.description: Simple products: attribute name to the chosen value's label.

coverStockId.description: Booklets: cover stock id, or self for a self cover.

designs.description: Several different designs with the same specs on one item, where get_product offers designs.

finishingIds.description: Finishing option ids, from every finishing field the customer chose.

height.description: Custom finished height in mm (with width).

pages.description: Booklets: page count, one of the pages field's presets.

quantity.description: How many. With designs above 1, how many of EACH design.

sizeId.description: A preset size id from get_product's size field. Or give width and height for a custom size.

stockId.description: Stock id from the stock field.

width.description: Custom finished width in mm (with height), within the size field's limits.

postcode.description: An Australian postcode (four digits) for the delivered price. Printdash delivers within Australia only.

name: price_job

extras.description: The same choices as short phrases; kept for older readers, prefer options.

options.description: The other choices as the product page labels them, for example Shape: Circle or Pages: 24, in the page's order.

title: Price a print job
